description: Domain vocabulary and four application ports. Every later CU compiles against these exact types, so this is the sole serial prerequisite.

Independent infrastructure adapters plus the collection-side port adapter: JSON manifest reader, HTTP probe, Rome validator, result store and ValidatedRssSource. Each writes a distinct file and only depends on wave 1.
Application orchestration and unit tests of the wave-2 adapters. SourceScanService depends on the adapters; the four unit specs depend on the same adapters and write separate test files.
Configuration and startup wiring plus integration/scale tests. Both depend on the wave-3 service and wave-2 adapter, and write disjoint files.
Final end-to-end verification alone: full ingestion and enrichment sbt compile/test, forbidden-path diff and no-opencode grep, recorded in the feature ITR report.
